courses.name: Advanced Life Support (ALS), Resuscitation Council UK

providers.name: Resuscitation Council UK (RCUK); delivered by RCUK-approved course centres

courses.audience: The ALS provider course is designed for healthcare professionals who need skills in Advanced Life Support as part of their clinical duties, as well as those who teach these skills on a regular basis.

audienceEvidence.quote: The ALS provider course is designed for healthcare professionals who need skills in Advanced Life Support as part of their clinical duties, as well as those who teach these skills on a regular basis.

courses.format: Two face-to-face days (lectures, workshops, skill stations, cardiac arrest simulations) after pre-course e-learning and manual; e-ALS = e-learning + one face-to-face day; recertification = one day; short recertification = half day.

formatEvidence.quote: This is a two day face-to-face course, and it will take place in a Resuscitation Council UK Course Centre.

courses.typicalLength: 2 days (e-ALS and recertification: 1 day; short recertification: half day)
courses.validityQuote: Candidates who successfully complete the course will be awarded with a Resuscitation Council UK ALS provider certificate, which is valid for four years and recognised in healthcare settings in the UK, Europe and Australia.
courses.feeNote: Fees are set by each RCUK course centre; RCUK lists no fee. RCUK page: "Course fees are decided locally by the Course Centre; Resuscitation Council UK only charges the Course Centre £31.57 per Candidate registration and £35.89 per ALS manual."
courses.cpdNote: check provider (RCUK says its courses are recognised as CPD by the Medical, Dental and Nursing Royal Colleges; points per course are on the RCUK FAQ table)

variants.e-als: e-ALS (e-learning + one-day face-to-face) | It involves one day of e-learning, which is done in your own time, before attending a one-day face-to-face course, providing increased flexibility and reducing the need for time away from work.
variants.recertification: ALS recertification, one day (certificate must be in date)
variants.short-recertification: ALS recertification short course, half day

courses.recognition: RCUK ALS page: "Our ALS qualification is recognised by the European Resuscitation Council and the Australian Resuscitation Council, giving you the freedom to use your lifesaving skills in other countries."

recognitionEvidence.quote: Our ALS qualification is recognised by the European Resuscitation Council and the Australian Resuscitation Council, giving you the freedom to use your lifesaving skills in other countries.
